node.label: Regenerative Brake Position
node.description: NOT Rheostatic Brake! The rheostatic brake burns rather than returns electricity!

node.label: Is movement allowed?
node.description: To prevent an increase in electricity consumption when an electric locomotive moves by inertia without traction.

object.script:
k=2.33873*(10^(-7)) c0=3.5*(10^(-6)) function onTick() Torque = input.getNumber(1) RPS = input.getNumber(2)
percentagePerSecond = c0 + Torque * k * RPS sWattPerSecond = 256000 * percentagePerSecond kilosWattPerHour = sWattPerSecond / 3600000
output.setNumber(1, k) output.setNumber(2, percentagePerSecond) output.setNumber(3, sWattPerSecond) output.setNumber(4, kilosWattPerHour) end
